tagline: I build reliable backend systems and grounded AI products, and ship them to production.
about: I'm a final-year Communication & Computer Engineering student at LNMIIT Jaipur. I build Java/Spring Boot and Python/FastAPI services with React/Next.js frontends.

I care about systems that stay correct under load. PulseOps, my multi-tenant monitoring platform, runs an event-driven pipeline on Kafka, Redis and PostgreSQL with race-free incident deduplication. Project Atlas, a grounded-RAG platform on Qdrant and LangGraph, answers only when it can cite evidence, and reached the finals of the Economic Times AI Hackathon 2.0.
Both projects are deployed on AWS through CI/CD pipelines, with automated tests. Outside engineering, I've trained as a Carnatic violinist for over ten years.
lookingFor: Software Development Engineer roles in backend, full-stack and applied AI.
